title: LTV,
name: LTV
touch: Every renewal after the first one.
t3: Under 3× CAC and the model doesn’t work.
formula: LTV = AVG REVENUE × GROSS MARGIN ÷ CHURN
def: Total gross profit one customer hands you before they leave.

title: CAC,
name: CAC
t3: Referrals and re-knocks cost almost nothing.
formula: CAC = SALES & MARKETING SPEND ÷ NEW CUSTOMERS
def: What it costs you to win one new customer.

title: ARR,
name: ARR
t3: Recurring revenue is what buyers pay up for.
def: The yearly value of the revenue that renews on its own.

title: Gross Margin,
name: Gross Margin
t3: Low margin means growth just means more work.
def: What you keep from each dollar after the direct cost of delivering.

title: Contribution Margin,
name: Contribution Margin
touch: The next sale, costed on its own.
t3: Negative here means growth makes you poorer.
formula: CONTRIBUTION = PRICE − VARIABLE COST PER UNIT
def: What one more sale actually adds before fixed costs.

title: Churn,
name: Churn
t3: Most churn happens in the first 90 days.
formula: CHURN = CUSTOMERS LOST ÷ CUSTOMERS AT START
def: The share of customers who leave in a period.

title: Net Dollar Retention,
name: Net Dollar Retention
t3: Over 100% means you grow without new sales.
def: How much revenue last year’s customers bring this year.

title: CAC Payback,
name: CAC Payback
t3: Under 12 months and you can fund your own growth.
def: How many months until a customer pays back what you spent to win them.

title: Cash Conversion Cycle,
name: Cash Conversion Cycle
t3: Deposits up front shrink this fastest.
def: Days your cash is tied up before it comes back.

title: DSO,
name: DSO
touch: The silence between invoice and payment.
t3: Deposits and shorter terms beat chasing.
def: How long you wait to get paid after you’ve done the work.

title: Working Capital,
name: Working Capital
scale:
What you have.
What you owe soon.
t3: Profitable companies still die from no cash.
formula: WORKING CAPITAL = CURRENT ASSETS − CURRENT LIABILITIES
def: The cash cushion that keeps the lights on.

title: Rep Ramp Time,
name: Rep Ramp Time
t3: Ride-alongs and scripts cut it in half.
formula: RAMP = DAYS UNTIL A REP HITS FULL QUOTA
def: How long a new hire takes to pay for themselves.

title: EBITDA,
name: EBITDA
t3: Companies sell for a multiple of it.
formula: EBITDA = NET INCOME + INTEREST + TAX + D&A
def: Profit before interest, taxes and depreciation. What buyers value you on.

title: Rule of 40,
name: Rule of 40
t3: Fast and broke or slow and rich can both pass.
def: A quick test of whether growth and profit are balanced.

title: Operating Leverage,
name: Operating Leverage
t3: It cuts both ways when sales drop.
formula: OP LEVERAGE = % CHANGE PROFIT ÷ % CHANGE SALES
def: Fixed costs make each extra sale more profitable.

title: Unit Economics.
name: Unit Economics
t3: If one customer loses money, more customers lose more.
def: Whether one customer makes or loses you money.
